ORDINARY RED SHAPE (FX03). Discovery yields exactly 18 methods (1+8+5+4); R4TestBase has only helpers (r4/plan/refused/run_argv/run_main/assert_cli_*/wrapped/counted/faulted/consumer_wrapper/case_scratch/copy_inputs/assert_inputs_unchanged - none named test*), so it contributes no tests and there is no extra inherited test class.
